release_read.basis: Reported Q3 revenue of $62.4M already includes ~27 days of LivePerson, so it only matches the stale ex-LPSN $61.7-63M bar and implies organic near $48-50M, well below the ~$62M organic consensus; the FY26 guide of $250-260M including LivePerson sits far below the $290-310M mechanical lift the thesis expected, and 2027 $350-400M is only maintained. Offsets: non-GAAP EPS -$0.05 vs about -$0.12/-0.13, a 27% workforce cut and an EBITDA-positive 2H27 target, into a 42%-of-float short.

release.headline: SoundHound AI Reports Record Q3 Revenue and Guides to Sustained Adjusted EBITDA Profitability within 2H 2027

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 3 estimates); basis GAAP vs non-GAAP not stated

key_line.metric: reported revenue incl. LivePerson stub / FY guide incl. LPSN
key_line.detail: Thesis was a headline beat from the unconsolidated LivePerson stub. Reported $62.4M includes LPSN from 2026-09-04, so there is no headline beat and organic is roughly $48-50M (my estimate; the release does not split it out) against Q2's $61.9M. Release time not stated in the release; the call was 17:00 ET on 2026-11-05, so the release was after the close.

guidance.detail: FY26 $250-260M (prior $230-260M, which excluded LPSN) vs the aggregator figure of $237.7M, but well below the ~$290-310M a full LPSN fold-in implied; 2027 $350-400M maintained; adj. EBITDA positive in 2H27; $120M of annualised cost synergies; 27% workforce cut started 2026-11-04.

call.detail: Call held last night. Its content was not reviewed in the time available; no number given only on the call is known.

public_reaction.summary: Not reviewed: there was no time before the 09:24 compile. Benzinga and TipRanks headlines in search results ('beats Q3 revenue estimates, raises outlook') are dated 2025 and are not this release.

tape_read.note: The robust reference is 4.15, -2.6% vs the 4.26 close. After hours was 3.94 (-7.5%), close to my -6% read, and the stock has since recovered toward the top of the 3.92-4.19 pre-market range, with QQQ up 1.7%. The pre-market is active (218 prints, 29 in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:19, not stale). It holds less of the downside than the release supports, probably from short covering and the cost-cut/EBITDA story. The long is still +2% over the 4.07 entry.

thesis_check.note: The LivePerson headline-beat thesis failed: the stub is already in the reported number, which only matches the stale bar, and the FY guide is a modest rather than a mechanical raise.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is active and not stale, so the open should hold the -2.6% move. The gap is small and has already climbed back from the after-hours -7.5%; with the release read lower, I expect a slight extension down rather than a fade by 10:00, though a 42% short and a strong QQQ could squeeze it.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers ondersteunen de koopthese niet: de omzet bevat LivePerson al en haalt alleen de oude, lage verwachting, en de jaarverwachting stijgt veel minder dan verwacht. De positie staat nog licht in de plus (circa 2% boven de instapprijs) omdat de voorbeurs zich van -7,5% naar -2,6% heeft hersteld. Neem dat mee en verkoop bij de opening, conform de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 actief boven 4,19 dollar (de voorbeurstop) uitbreekt, wijst dat op een short squeeze en kan een limietorder iets daarboven beter zijn dan verkopen bij de opening.
